LESSON: ORAL EXPRESSION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking Oral expression Pronunciation, intonation, active listeni
Topic 1.1: Oral Expression
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Oral Expression, part of Listening and Speaking Oral expression Pronunciation, intonation, active listeni in Grade 7 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: what they hear, Why are correct pronunciation and intonation important in oral communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch an audio-visual clip on informal Chinese greetings and numbers (1-100) and repeat saying them with the correct tones(吃了吗 ? 你今天怎么样 ? 你最 近怎么样 ? 最近好吗 ? 大家好),

2. work jointly to arrange the words and phrases in the right sequence from the audio clip,

3. answer questions from the oral text,

4. introduce oneself (informal greetings, name, age, and place of residence) with appropriate pronunciation and intonation (e.g. 大家好,我叫......,我今年......岁, 我住在......),

5. take turns introducing their friends (name, age, and place of residence),

6. listen to an authentic text with various accents/speech patterns and repeat

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch an audio-visual clip on informal Chinese greetings and numbers (1-100) and repeat saying them with the correct tones(吃了吗 ? 你今天怎么样 ? 你最 近怎么样 ? 最近好吗 ? 大家好),
2. work jointly to arrange the words and phrases in the right sequence from the audio clip,
3. answer questions from the oral text,
4. introduce oneself (informal greetings, name, age, and place of residence) with appropriate pronunciation and intonation (e.g. 大家好,我叫......,我今年......岁, 我住在......),
5. take turns introducing their friends (name, age, and place of residence),
6. listen to an authentic text with various accents/speech patterns and repeat

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Oral Expression together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: the learner works collaboratively with others to arrange words in the right sequence.

• Communication and Collaboration: the learner speaks clearly and effectively using appropriate language, expression, and

gestures as they introduce themselves and their friends to their peers.

Values:
Respect: the learner is patient and waits for their turn to make simple introductions about their friends.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Cultural Awareness: this is developed when the learner uses informal greetings appropriately fostering sensitivity and

appreciation for diverse customs and traditions.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the skills of using correct tone and pronunciation to convey appropriate meaning while communicating in

English and Kiswahili.
